evidence: The function requests a two-float value through f_7001822a34, computes its magnitude with compute_curved_vector_magnitude, compares it with 1.5, and on the qualifying path maps the negated second component and first component through f_70000a91c0 before indexing a table at 0x7001d762e0 (decompiled/main/main_0100.c:46962-46987). Three callers pass an output pointer at x1 and use the return value, but their surrounding code does not identify the vector domain or table semantics (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:43559-43570; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:18939-18950; decompiled/main/main_0119.c:20023-20034). Left unnamed.

Initializes the caller-provided 32-bit output to zero. If the global context pointer exists, it queries attribute-context selector 0x13 and continues only when the returned byte is 4; it then calls f_70006b56c0 with the context and selector 0x1b and writes 1 to the output only when that call returns true (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:52864-52890). No indexed callers are available.

Converts three scalar inputs to integers, obtains a fourth integer from the scratch/value area at base+0xa5c4, and invokes the established format_signed_integer_with_thousands_separators helper for each value. The four output buffers begin at base offsets 0x10, 0x90, 0x110, and 0x190, each with capacity 0x80; the caller gathers three values and tail-calls this routine (decompiled/main/main_0073.c:13055-13083; caller decompiled/main/main_0071.c:37302-37311).

Checks the global pointer at 0x700463d000+0xc40 and returns if already set. Otherwise allocates 0xb80 bytes, initializes the record bundle, stores the pointer, and invokes a setup helper with the caller flag; if setup fails, it releases the bundle and clears the global pointer (decompiled/main/main_0165.c:14307-14336). It is called from initialize_player_hair_color_subsystem (decompiled/main/main_0076.c:20821-20841), which supports the hair-color subsystem scope.

When the incoming enable parameter is nonzero, loads a non-null entry through the pointer in x3, passes it through helper checks, reads the current value at object offset 0x3570, and calls attribute_context_entry_is_compatible with selector 7. Only on a true result does it call f_700076cba0 with the same value and selector 7, then it runs a follow-up helper (decompiled/main/main_0083.c:9180-9206). The exact domain role is not established, so the name stays at the visible update behavior.
